name: What kind of maintenance does a concrete walkway require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does a concrete walkway require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Concrete walkways are relatively low maintenance. Regular sweeping or hosing down to remove dirt and debris is usually sufficient. It's advisable to seal the concrete every 2-5 years, depending on the sealer type and environmental exposure, to protect against stains, moisture, and general wear. Promptly address any cracks or chips to prevent them from worsening. Avoid using de-icing salts, as they can damage the concrete surface over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance includes regular cleaning, resealing every 2-5 years to protect against stains and moisture, and prompt repair of any damage.
